title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Tuesday, 17 November 2026
description: United Airlines blocks unauthorised AI agents from booking flights, Australia's big four banks wrap up a mixed full-year reporting season, Brisbane's Olympic stadium moves through early works, and construction begins on a new Gold Coast apartment development at Kirra Beach. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
